captures.description: ATTRIBUTIONBENCH, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'a comprehensive research benchmark designed to evaluate automatic attribution and citation faithfulness in Large Language Model (LLM) and generative search engine responses.' A unified testbed of seven datasets (ExpertQA, Stanford-GenSearch, AttributedQA, LFQA, BEGIN, HAGRID, AttrEval-GenSearch), the task (is every claim fully supported by its cited evidence: attributable or not), the data on Hugging Face and GitHub; findings (about 80% macro-F1 for GPT-4 and fine-tuned GPT-3.5, 60–70% on harder sets; over 66% of errors from fine-grained information insensitivity, nearly 27% from a mismatch of access and context). Five cards: arXiv 2402.15089, the OSU-NLP-Group repository, the project page, the Hugging Face dataset, the ACL Anthology.

Core Task: It measures whether every claim generated by an LLM is fully and accurately supported by its cited reference evidence (classified as `attributable` or `not attributable`).

Unified Testbed: It compiles multiple existing attribution datasets—including ExpertQA, Stanford-GenSearch, AttributedQA, LFQA, BEGIN, HAGRID, and AttrEval-GenSearch—into a single standardized evaluation format.
